title: Add and Subtract with Tens and Hundreds

stageA.studentFacingAuthenticTask: Students physically roll number cubes and add/subtract tens and hundreds using blocks; each roll differs and cannot be assigned one official numeric result.
stageA.originalMediaAndHumanLimits: Real dice rolls, blocks, partner drawing and justifications are teacher-observed; independent numerical practice not presented as publisher original.
